description: Activate when: user says 'what's the most likely explanation,' 'why did this happen,' 'we think it's X but not sure,' 'we only have one theory,' 'the team has converged on an answer without checking alternatives,' or when diagnosing a bug/outage/symptom/anomaly under uncertainty. Do NOT activate when: the problem is purely deductive or mathematical (direct proof, not hypothesis); the situation allows direct observation or measurement that bypasses inference. More: deciqai.com/c/abductive-reasoning
